en: The image is a sepia-toned or black-and-white historical illustration of a walled city surrounded by hills, featuring multiple towers, fortified walls, and a large central church with a tall spire. In the foreground, there are figures in period clothing and livestock, indicating a rural or pastoral setting outside the city walls. At the top, the text reads: 'COLOS WAR vulgo CLAVSENBURG, Transilvania Civitas Primaria.'
